about_the_game:
Take to the skies in your flying saucer, blast buildings to rubble, vaporize tanks, and - of course - abduct Earthlings with your tractor beam in this fast-paced sci-fi side-scroller!

This demo is a brief introduction to the world of FOOLISH EARTHLINGS! A game where you take on the role of an unimaginable terror from beyond the stars and must abduct as many Earthlings to take back to your mothership as you can before time runs out or Earth's puny armies render their vengeance upon you!
